feature: official grpc-cpp pick_first interoperability and endpoint failover

scope.direction: official grpc-cpp client to netz server
scope.assertion_owner: upstream InteropClient::DoPickFirstUnary requires every response to carry the same server_id

netz_client_failover.sequence: canonical unary on grpc-cpp A, retire A, start grpc-cpp B, second wait-for-ready unary on the same SharedChannel

reference.implementation: grpc-core C++ interop_client and two independently managed interop_server processes

implementation.fixture_codec: decodePickFirstRequest accepts exactly protobuf field 9 varint true; encodeServerIdResponseAlloc emits exactly field 4 with bounded UTF-8 identity
implementation.server: one persistent HTTP/2 connection serves 100 sequential unary calls with one stable server identity
implementation.runner: pick_first_unary is part of every h2c/TLS reverse matrix
implementation.failover_runner: the forward gate starts only server A for phase one, retires it after an explicit client marker, then starts preconfigured server B before phase two
implementation.dns: the case enables service-config resolution; the runner disables only upstream event_engine_dns and selects upstream native DNS to preserve the pick-first channel while avoiding an unrelated _grpc_config.127.0.0.1 TXT query
implementation.tls: upstream's pick-first-specific channel helper selects credentials through custom_credentials_type=ssl instead of its ordinary use_tls branch

results.reverse_matrix: 24 scenarios per transport, including pick_first_unary, passed over h2c and TLS
results.forward_matrix: netz client to grpc-cpp server complete h2c/TLS matrix passed
results.pick_first_tls: 100/100 unary calls, stable server_id, certificate verified, ALPN h2
results.failover_h2c: same SharedChannel completed endpoint order 0->1 with two canonical full-byte unary validations
results.failover_tls: same SharedChannel completed endpoint order 0->1 with two canonical full-byte unary validations, certificate verified, ALPN h2

BAZEL=/nav_env/Temp/netz-grpc-bazel-bin/bazel-8.7.0-linux-arm64 CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ zig build interop-grpc-cpp -Doptimize=ReleaseFast --summary all
remaining_gap: Standard single-server pick_first and real two-endpoint A-to-B failover are externally covered. Max-concurrent-stream connection scaling and broader repeated/fault-injected failover distributions remain separate conformance work.
